topic_ko: 실시간 데이터가 디지털 트윈을 역동적 복제본으로 바꾸다
_note: 원문 유형은 무관한 문장. irrelevant를 가장 강하게 구성하고, 유형마다 passage를 다르게 paraphrase 한다.

passage: A digital twin is a virtual duplicate of an asset or an activity, built from models and sensor readings.
The idea itself is hardly recent, since engineers have relied on 3D renderings and process simulations for many years.
What has changed is the speed of wireless networks and the flood of real-time data they deliver.
With that data, digital representations can be far more detailed and far more dynamic than before.
Sensors on a connected device feed measurements back to the model without pause.
The twin therefore mirrors the properties and states of the physical object as they actually are.
Industries adopt such twins where equipment is expensive and stoppages are ruinous.
Turbines, jet engines, and train engines are among the first machines to receive them.
choices: why engineers abandoned older 3D rendering tools for good
how faster networks and live data turned digital models into real-time twins
why emotional and cultural factors matter most in engineering design
how manufacturers reduce the cost of building large turbines
why wireless networks spread faster in industry than in homes
theme.explanation_ko: 오래전부터 있던 디지털 모델이 빠른 무선망과 실시간 데이터 덕분에 실시간 트윈으로 바뀌었다는 내용. ②가 주제.
theme.distractor_ko: ①옛 도구 폐기, ③감정·문화 요인, ④터빈 제작비 절감, ⑤무선망 보급 속도는 본문 초점이 아니다.

passage: We should stop treating digital twins as a brand-new invention.
Engineering teams have worked with 3D renderings and process simulations for many years already.
What deserves our attention instead is the arrival of fast wireless networks and real-time data.
These make digital representations far more detailed and far more dynamic than the old models were.
Sensors on connected devices should be allowed to update the twin without interruption.
Only then does the twin become an accurate copy of the object's properties and states.
Companies must apply this approach first to assets whose downtime is ruinously expensive.
Turbines and jet engines are exactly the machines that repay such continuous monitoring.
choices: 디지털 트윈은 완전히 새로운 기술이므로 신중히 도입해야 한다.
실시간 데이터로 끊임없이 갱신되는 디지털 트윈을 고가 자산에 우선 적용해야 한다.
3D 렌더링 기술은 이제 산업 현장에서 폐기되어야 한다.
디지털 트윈은 감정적·문화적 요인까지 반영하도록 설계되어야 한다.
무선 네트워크 속도보다 센서의 개수를 늘리는 것이 더 중요하다.
claim.explanation_ko: 핵심은 실시간 데이터로 계속 갱신되는 트윈을 비가동 비용이 큰 자산에 우선 적용하자는 주장. ②.
claim.distractor_ko: ①새로운 기술이라는 전제부터 본문과 반대, ③렌더링 폐기, ④감정·문화 반영, ⑤센서 개수는 본문 주장이 아니다.

passage: Digital twins copy assets or activities into virtual form through modeling and sensors.
Such copies are not a novelty, as industry has used them in simpler forms for years.
Faster wireless networks now supply data the moment it is measured.
That constant supply makes the digital representation both richer and more responsive.
Every reading from a connected device refreshes the model again.
As a result, the twin tracks the object's properties and states in real time.
The approach spreads fastest where machinery is valuable and idleness is expensive.
Power turbines and aircraft engines illustrate that pattern clearly.
choices: 디지털 트윈은 최근에야 처음 고안된 기술이다.
센서보다 설계 도면이 자산 관리에 더 유용하다.
실시간 데이터 덕분에 디지털 트윈이 훨씬 정교하고 역동적인 복제본이 되었다.
무선 네트워크는 산업 현장에서 잦은 오류를 일으킨다.
값비싼 장비일수록 디지털 모델링이 불필요하다.
gist.explanation_ko: 실시간 데이터가 디지털 트윈을 정교하고 역동적인 실시간 복제본으로 만들었다는 것이 요지. ③.
gist.distractor_ko: ①최신 발명, ②도면 우위, ④네트워크 오류, ⑤고가 장비 불필요는 모두 본문과 어긋난다.

passage: Modeling and sensors together produce a virtual duplicate known as a digital twin.
Engineers have long built 3D renderings, asset models, and process simulations of this kind.
The genuine novelty lies in networks fast enough to move data as it is created.
Representations built on such data are markedly more detailed and more dynamic.
Readings from connected devices flow in and refresh the model continuously.
What results is an accurate live mirror of the object's properties and states.
The technique takes hold wherever equipment is costly and downtime unaffordable.
Turbines and jet engines have become familiar examples.
choices: The Hidden Cost of Building Industrial Turbines
Why Simulations Can Never Replace Real Machines
Wireless Networks: A Short History of Speed
From Static Models to Living Copies: The Rise of Real-Time Twins
Teaching Machines to Understand Human Culture
title.explanation_ko: 정적인 모델이 실시간 복제본으로 진화했다는 내용을 압축한 ④가 제목.
title.distractor_ko: ①터빈 제작비, ②시뮬레이션 무용론, ③무선망 역사, ⑤기계의 문화 이해는 초점이 아니다.

passage: A digital twin begins as an ordinary virtual model of a machine.
For years such models sat still, redrawn only when an engineer chose to redraw them.
Fast wireless networks changed that by delivering measurements the instant they are taken.
Now the sensor data keeps the drawing breathing with the machine.
Each new reading nudges the model toward the object's present condition.
The twin thus reports properties and states that are genuinely current.
Owners of costly equipment value this most, because stoppages drain money quickly.
Turbines and jet engines are watched this way every hour of the day.
implication.underlined: keeps the drawing breathing with the machine
choices: the model is redrawn once a year by an engineer
the model changes moment by moment along with the real machine
the machine copies the movements shown in the drawing
the drawing replaces the machine in daily operation
the machine stops whenever the drawing is updated
implication.explanation_ko: '도면이 기계와 함께 숨 쉬게 한다'는 비유는 모델이 실물과 함께 순간순간 변한다는 뜻이다. ②.
implication.distractor_ko: ①연 1회 갱신(정반대), ③기계가 도면을 따라감, ④도면이 기계를 대체, ⑤갱신 시 정지는 모두 다르다.

passage: Digital twins are digital replicas of assets or activities using modeling and sensors.
The concept is not new, and engineering teams have use 3D renderings for years.
However, faster wireless networks enable much more detailed digital representations.
When sensors collect data from a connected device, the data can be used to update the twin.
The digital twin becomes an accurate copy of a physical object's properties and states.
Companies adopt twins where assets are valuable and downtime is costly.
Turbines and jet engines are among the machines monitored in this way.
Such monitoring is becoming common across many industries.
grammar._grammar_note: ② 'have use' 가 비문법. 현재완료는 have + 과거분사이므로 'have used' 가 옳다.
choices: ①
②

grammar.explanation_ko: 현재완료는 have 뒤에 과거분사가 와야 하므로 ②는 'have used'가 되어야 한다. ②가 정답.
grammar.distractor_ko: ① replicas를 수식하는 현재분사 using, ③ 비교급 강조 much, ④ be used to + 동사원형, ⑤ machines를 수식하는 과거분사 monitored는 모두 옳다.

vocab.distractor_ko: ①복제본 ②이용 가능한 ④지속적으로 ⑤비용이 큰은 문맥상 모두 적절하다.

order.given: Digital twins are digital replicas of assets or activities, created through modeling and sensors. The concept itself is not new at all.

blocks.A: Because those readings arrive without pause, the twin becomes an accurate live copy of the object's properties and states.
blocks.B: Engineering teams across many industries have worked with 3D renderings, asset models, and process simulations for years.
blocks.C: However, faster wireless networks and the real-time data they supply now allow sensors to feed the model continuously.

order.explanation_ko: 주어진 글이 '새롭지 않다'로 끝나므로 (B)가 오랜 사용 사례로 그것을 뒷받침하고, (C)의 However가 달라진 점을 제시하며, (A)의 'those readings'가 (C)의 센서 데이터를 받는다. (B)-(C)-(A).
order.distractor_ko: (A)의 those readings는 가리킬 대상이 앞에 있어야 하므로 먼저 올 수 없고, (C)의 However도 (B)의 '오래된 관행' 뒤라야 대조가 성립한다.

summary.summary_template: Although digital models are not new, real-time data now makes them __(A)__ , which matters most for assets whose downtime is __(B)__ .

writing.question: 다음 우리말과 같은 뜻이 되도록 <보기>의 단어를 모두 배열하여 영작하시오.
writing.explanation_ko: 복수 주어 Digital twins + be동사 are + not new.

writing.question: 다음 우리말과 같은 뜻이 되도록 <보기>의 단어를 모두 배열하여 영작하시오.
writing.ko_prompt: 디지털 트윈은 물리적 대상의 속성과 상태를 실시간으로 정확하게 복제한 것이 된다.
writing.answer: The digital twin becomes a real-time accurate copy of a physical object's properties and states.
writing.explanation_ko: 2형식 become + 명사 보어(a copy), 소유격 object's가 properties and states를 수식.

writing.question: 다음 우리말을 <조건>에 맞게 영작하시오.
writing.ko_prompt: 그 센서 데이터는 디지털 트윈을 지속적으로 갱신하는 데 사용될 수 있다.
conditions: be used to + 동사원형 형태를 쓸 것
writing.answer: The sensor data can be used to continuously update the digital twin.
writing.explanation_ko: be used to + 동사원형(~하는 데 쓰이다) + 부사 continuously.

writing.question: 다음 글을 읽고, 흐름상 빈칸에 들어갈 한 단어를 본문에서 찾아 쓰시오.
writing.context: A period when a valuable machine is not operating is called ___________, and it can be extremely costly.
writing.explanation_ko: 설비가 멈춰 있는 시간을 본문은 'downtime(비가동 시간)'이라 부른다.

writing.question: 다음 밑줄 친 문장을 우리말로 해석하시오.
writing.en_prompt: However, faster wireless networks and the resulting availability of real-time data enable much more detailed and dynamic digital representations.
writing.answer: 그러나 더 빨라진 무선 네트워크와 그로 인한 실시간 데이터의 이용 가능성은 훨씬 더 상세하고 역동적인 디지털 표현물을 가능하게 한다.
writing.explanation_ko: resulting(그 결과로 생긴), availability(이용 가능성), much + 비교급(훨씬 더 ~한).

writing.question: 다음 글의 내용을 한 문장으로 요약할 때, 빈칸 (A)와 (B)에 들어갈 한 단어를 각각 쓰시오.
writing.summary: Digital twins are not a recent idea, but (A)___________ data from sensors now keeps them updated so continuously that they mirror an object's properties and (B)___________ .
writing.explanation_ko: (A)는 본문의 real-time data, (B)는 properties and states에서 가져온다.
